remarks:
Welcome to this very well-maintained home filled with character and charm from the moment you step into the spacious front foyer. Beautiful natural woodwork and hardwood floors throughout add warmth and timeless appeal. Large glass-door bookcases surround the decorative fireplace, creating a wonderful focal point in the living space.

The enclosed front porch offers additional flexible space that could be used as a den, home office, reading room, or whatever best suits your needs. The partially finished basement provides even more space for entertaining, relaxing, or hobbies.

Most of the windows have been replaced, while some of the original windows have been thoughtfully preserved to maintain the home’s classic character. Outside, enjoy the inviting patio—perfect for relaxing or entertaining—or step out onto the covered upper deck/balcony off the bedroom for some fresh air and additional outdoor enjoyment.

Don't miss your opportunity to see this beautiful home that perfectly blends classic charm with comfortable living!
